Newly refurbished throughout, the property features two generously sized double bedrooms, each providing comfortable and versatile accommodation ideal for professionals, couples or sharers. The contemporary open plan kitchen and living area is thoughtfully designed to maximise space and natural light, with high quality fittings and modern appliances creating a sleek and functional environment for both relaxing and entertaining. Located just a short walk from Leytonstone Station, the property offers excellent transport links to central London and beyond, making it an ideal base for commuters. A wide range of local amenities are close at hand, including supermarkets, independent cafes, restaurants and leisure facilities, providing everything needed for a vibrant and convenient lifestyle. The nearby high street offers a variety of shopping options, while several reputable schools and healthcare services are also within easy reach. With its combination of contemporary style, practical layout and prime location, this second floor flat represents a superb choice for those looking to enjoy all that Leytonstone has to offer. Early viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality and appeal of this exceptional home.
